svg.title: Your turn: follow the north arrow
svg.desc: Modern city reference points: Manila on Luzon is north of Cebu City in the Visayas. Davao City on Mindanao is south of Cebu City. Water lies between these islands. These modern names locate places, not ancient settlements.
svg.text: Your turn: follow the north arrow

g.text: Green = Philippine land; pale green = nearby land; blue = water.
Simplified modern locator | Natural Earth, public domain | Small islands omitted; not a boundary map.
